name: URLShield
shortDescription: Explainable phishing-URL classification with offline structural features and honest estimates.
features: 12 explainable structural URL features (extractor independent of the model)
Logistic-regression baseline with stratified hold-out evaluation (precision/recall/F1/confusion)
Explicit operating threshold; predictions carry probabilities + disclaimers
Deterministic SYNTHETIC dataset (labelled fictional demo data)
Model registry with metadata (features, dataset note, metrics)
knownLimitations: Synthetic dataset: real-world performance unverified (stated in-product)
Predictions are estimates, never proof; 'not-flagged' is not a safety guarantee
